q: Regarding breast milk, all are true EXCEPT:
o: Lactoferrin inhibits growth of E. coli
Fore-milk has more fat than hind-milk
Its fatty acid pattern reflects maternal diet
e: Hind-milk, at the end of the feed, is the fat-rich part.

q: Comparing breast milk with formula, which is NOT correct?
o: Breast milk has a higher percentage of protein
Breast milk contains leucocytes and lysozyme
Breast milk has less iron than iron-fortified formula
Breast milk has a Ca : PO₄ ratio of 2 : 1
e: Breast milk has less protein than cow's milk and formula.

q: An absolute contraindication to breastfeeding is:
e: Galactosaemia is the absolute contraindication in the baby.

q: A 12-month-old who began whole cow's milk at 6 months is most likely to have:
e: Cow's milk is poor in absorbable iron and causes occult GI blood loss → iron deficiency.
Breast milk alone meets needs until 6 months.
